deathcamera.config.title: Death Camera
deathcamera.config.enableOrbit.desc: Orbit the camera around the corpse. If off, plain third-person view.
deathcamera.config.staticMode.desc: Only when rotation is off (enableOrbit off, or third-person view off). While orbit is on, it takes over.
deathcamera.config.forceThirdPerson.desc: Automatically switch to third-person camera. Restored after respawn.
deathcamera.config.speed.desc: Degrees per tick. 0.45 is about one lap in 40 seconds. Lower is slower.
deathcamera.config.height.desc: Camera height above the death point, in blocks (-5 to 5).
deathcamera.config.targetHeightOffset.de: Height of the camera focus point above the death point, in blocks (1 to 5). 1.0 is about chest level.
deathcamera.config.keepChunks.desc: The world doesn't pause on the death screen, and the dead player is kept on the server, so chunks stay loaded and mobs don't disappear.
deathcamera.config.hideCorpse.desc: Never show your own corpse, from the very first frame. Without it, vanilla removes the corpse after ~1 second. Other players are not affected, no server mod needed.
deathcamera.config.removeRedScreen.desc: Removes the red gradient on the death screen, the world stays clear.
deathcamera.config.deathKeepSeconds.desc: How long to keep chunks loaded after death. 0 is vanilla (holding is off even if the toggle above is on), -1 is unlimited.
deathcamera.config.compactDeathScreen.de: Moves death screen texts higher up. Off is the vanilla layout.
deathcamera.config.cinematicFov.desc: Smoothly widens FOV on first-person death. Does nothing in third person. When off, FOV stays at your setting in any perspective. Restored automatically after respawn.
deathcamera.config.fovStart.desc: FOV value the widening starts from (30-100). The sweep always ends at 110.
deathcamera.config.fovDurationSec.desc: How many seconds the FOV takes to go from start to 110.
deathcamera.config.transitionDurationSec: How many seconds the camera glides into the orbit point. Third person only: from first person the camera is placed instantly.
deathcamera.config.buttonsHeight.desc: How high above the bottom edge the death screen buttons sit, in pixels.
deathcamera.config.textsHeight.desc: How many pixels the death screen texts move up.
deathcamera.config.hideHud.desc: Hides hotbar, XP, crosshair and other HUD on the death screen.
